layers.name: lefthand
layers.note: Two-handed weapon, shield or light source.

layers.name: cloak
layers.note: Quivers occupy this layer on most shards.

layers.name: mount
layers.note: Your mount, when you are riding.

attack.description: Attacks a specific serial, or a variable holding one. If the serial is already your last target, this repeats the last attack instead.

params.name: serial
params.desc: Mobile to attack, or a variable that resolves to one.

cast.description: Casts a spell by name or number. For spells that need a target, follow with waitfortarget and a target command.

params.name: 'name of spell'
params.desc: Spell name, or its spell number.

dclick.description: Uses (double-clicks) a specific item or mobile. Instead of a serial you can pass 'left', 'right' or 'hands' to use what you are holding. 'useobject' is an alias.

dclicktype.summary: Double-clicks the first matching item by name or type.
dclicktype.description: Finds an item by Tiledata name or graphic ID and uses it. It is the acting twin of findtype and takes the same arguments. Falls back to mobiles if no item matches. 'usetype' is an alias.

params.name: 'name' | graphic
params.desc: Tiledata name (supports the %s% plural wildcard) or graphic ID.

params.name: source
params.desc: backpack, self (worn, including container contents), ground, a container serial, or true/false for the CE range check. 'any' skips the slot.

params.name: hue
params.desc: Restrict to one colour. 'any' to ignore.

dress.description: Equips everything in a dress list you defined on the Arm/Dress tab. You can also pass an item serial to equip a single item.

params.name: 'name of dress list'
params.desc: Dress list name, or an item serial.

undress.summary: Unequips everything, a dress list, or one layer.
undress.description: With no argument you strip completely. Pass a dress list to remove only those items, or a layer name to clear a single layer.

params.name: 'name' | 'layer'
params.desc: Dress list name, layer name, or item serial.

drop.description: Drops the held item at your feet, onto a layer, or at a specific location. Lift something first.

droprelloc.summary: Drops the held item relative to you.
droprelloc.description: Drops what you are holding at an offset from your own position.

lift.description: Lifts a specific item. The script waits until the item is actually in hand before moving on.

params.name: amount
params.desc: How many from the stack. Defaults to 1.

lifttype.summary: Picks up an item by name or type.
lifttype.description: Lifts the first matching item. Searches your backpack unless you name another source.

params.name: source
params.desc: backpack (default), self, ground, or a container serial.

say.description: Makes your character say the message. Pet commands and other keyword speech work as if you typed it. 'msg' is an alias.

whisper.description: Speaks quietly, so only mobiles very close to you hear it.

yell.description: Speaks loudly, so it carries much further than normal speech.

emote.description: Sends the message as an emote. Razor wraps it in *asterisks* for you.

guild.description: Sends the message to your guild.

alliance.description: Sends the message to your guild alliance.

overhead.summary: Shows a message above your head that only you can see.
overhead.description: Draws a private message over your character (or another mobile). Nobody else sees it; it is never sent to the server. Supports {{...}} interpolation: {{myvar}} inserts a variable, and an expression such as {{skill 'Alchemy'}} or {{hits}} inserts its current value. 'headmsg' is an alias.

params.name: 'text'
params.desc: Message. {{name}} inserts a variable; {{expression args}} inserts the expression's value, e.g. {{skill 'Alchemy'}} or {{hits}}.

params.name: serial
params.desc: Show it over this mobile instead of you.

overhead.example:
if stam = 100
    overhead 'ready to go!' 68
endif

overhead "Alchemy: {{skill 'Alchemy'}}" 88
overhead 'hp {{hits}}/{{maxhits}}'

sysmsg.summary: Writes to the system message area, where only you can see it.
sysmsg.description: Prints a message in the lower-left of the client. Local only. Supports {{...}} interpolation: {{myvar}} inserts a variable, and an expression such as {{skill 'Alchemy'}} or {{hits}} inserts its current value. 'sysmessage' is an alias.

params.name: 'text'
params.desc: Message. {{name}} inserts a variable; {{expression args}} inserts the expression's value, e.g. {{skill 'Alchemy'}} or {{hits}}.

clearsysmsg.summary: Empties the message queue that insysmsg reads.
clearsysmsg.description: Razor keeps a buffer of recent system messages for insysmsg and waitforsysmsg. This clears it. Do that before waiting for a message you expect soon, so an old one cannot match. 'clearjournal' is an alias.

wait.description: Stops the script for a while. Add a unit to write it in seconds or minutes instead of milliseconds. 'pause' is an alias.

params.name: 's' | 'm'
params.desc: Unit: seconds or minutes. Also accepts sec/secs/second/seconds, min/mins/minute/minutes.

waitforsysmsg.summary: Waits until a system message appears.
waitforsysmsg.description: Blocks until the given text shows up in the message queue. Substring match. 'wfsysmsg' is an alias.

params.name: timeout
params.desc: Milliseconds before giving up. Defaults to 30000.

waitfortarget.description: Blocks until a target cursor is up. Put this between a cast/skill and the target command. 'wft' is an alias.

params.name: timeout
params.desc: Milliseconds before giving up. Defaults to 30000.

target.description: Targets a serial directly, or picks a mobile by proximity. Notoriety accepts a comma list (any match) or an exclamation list (priority order: try the first, fall back to the next). Type narrows to 'humanoid' or 'monster'. Also takes 'cancel' and 'clear'.

params.name: serial | mode
params.desc: A serial, or closest / random / next / prev / cancel / clear.

params.name: notoriety
params.desc: innocent, friend, friendly, grey, criminal, enemy, murderer, nonfriendly. Comma = any, exclamation = priority.

target.example:
cast 'lightning'
waitfortarget
target 'closest' 'enemy' 'monster'

# priority: try enemies first, then criminals
target 'closest' 'enemy!criminal'

targettype.summary: Answers a target cursor with an item or mobile by type.
targettype.description: Finds an object the same way findtype does, then targets it.

params.name: source
params.desc: backpack, self, ground, container serial, or true/false. 'any' skips.

targetloc.description: Answers a ground target cursor with a fixed world location.

targetrelloc.summary: Targets a location relative to you.
targetrelloc.description: Answers a ground target cursor at an offset from your own position.
targetrelloc.sagasNote: The target uses your own Z rather than the height of the tile you are aiming at, because Razor has no access to the map files. This is fine on flat ground. On stairs or multi-level terrain it can miss.

lasttarget.description: Answers the cursor with whatever Razor has stored as Last Target.

setlasttarget.description: Stores a serial as Razor's Last Target without targeting anything.

hotkey.summary: Runs any Razor hotkey by name.
hotkey.description: Executes a hotkey exactly as if you pressed it. This is the bridge to everything the assistant can do that has no command of its own. Use the name shown on the Hot Keys tab.

params.name: 'name of hotkey'
params.desc: Display name, exactly as on the Hot Keys tab. A numeric index also works.

hotkey.example:
skill 'detect hidden'
waitfortarget
hotkey 'target self'

hotkey 'Bandage self'

skill.description: Invokes a usable skill, the same as clicking its button in the skills window. Pass 'last' to repeat the previous one. 'useskill' is an alias.

params.name: 'name of skill' | 'last'
params.desc: Skill name with spaces removed, e.g. animallore, detectinghidden.

skill.example:
while mana < maxmana
    skill 'meditation'
    wait 11000
endwhile

setskill.description: Changes whether a skill goes up, goes down, or is locked, the same as clicking the arrow in the skills window. Works on any skill, not just usable ones.

params.name: 'skill name'
params.desc: Skill name with spaces removed, e.g. blacksmithing.

warmode.summary: Turns war mode on or off.
warmode.description: Switches your character between peace and war mode.

walk.description: Moves your character one step. Razor throttles this to roughly one step every 0.4s, so a walk in a tight loop will not spam the server.

params.name: 'direction'
params.desc: North, South, East, West, Up, Down, Left, Right.

potion.summary: Drinks a potion from your backpack.
potion.description: Finds and drinks a potion by type.

params.name: 'type'
params.desc: heal, cure, refresh, nightsight (ns), explosion, strength (str), agility.

potion.sagasNote: If 'Block heal while poisoned' is enabled in Options, a heal potion is refused while you are poisoned. Cure first.

virtue.description: Invokes one of the three virtues.

setability.description: Sets a weapon ability or special move. Defaults to 'on' when you omit the state.

params.name: 'on' | 'off'
params.desc: Defaults to on. 'off' clears the armed ability.

interrupt.summary: Cancels the spell you are casting.
interrupt.description: Interrupts your own cast by equipping and unequipping, so you do not waste the mana on a spell you no longer want.

params.name: layer
params.desc: Layer to use for the interrupt.

interrupt.example:
cast 'greater heal'
if hp = maxhp
    interrupt
endif
interrupt.sagasNote: The layer argument is accepted but ignored. There is one generic interrupt path.

clearall.summary: Resets everything Razor is in the middle of.
clearall.description: Cancels the target cursor, empties the action queues and drops whatever you are holding. A good first line for a script that must start from a known state.

clearhands.description: Moves the item in the named hand back to your backpack.

cleardragdrop.description: Stops Razor's pending lift/drop actions without dropping what you hold.

random.description: Shows a random number between 1 and max as a system message.

sound.summary: Plays a sound that only you can hear.
sound.description: Plays a sound effect locally at your position. Useful as an alert.

music.summary: Plays a music track that only you can hear.

rename.description: Renames a mobile you control. The name must be longer than one character.

getlabel.summary: Reads an object's label into a variable.
getlabel.description: Single-clicks the object and collects every label line the server sends back into a variable. Use the 'in' operator to test the result.

params.name: variable
params.desc: Variable name to store the label text in.

getlabel.example:
if findtype 3852 self as pot
    getlabel pot potlabel
    if 'next usable' in potlabel
        sysmsg 'not ready'
    endif
endif

ignore.summary: Adds a serial to the ignore list.
ignore.description: Ignored serials are skipped by findtype, dclicktype, targettype and friends. Pass a list name to ignore every entry in it.

params.name: serial | 'list name'
params.desc: One serial, or a list of them.

ignore.example:
if findtype 'corpse' ground as body
    ignore body
endif

unignore.summary: Removes a serial from the ignore list.
unignore.description: Undoes ignore for one serial or for every entry of a list.

params.name: serial | 'list name'
params.desc: One serial, or a list of them.

cooldown.description: Starts a timer you can read back with the cooldown expression. It is the clean way to stop a loop from repeating an action too early.
cooldown.example:
cooldown 'bandage' 30000

if cooldown 'bandage' > 2000
    overhead 'not yet'
endif
cooldown.sagasNote: The duration is in milliseconds. Older scripts that pass seconds keep working: a value below 100 is read as seconds. The on-screen cooldown bar is not implemented yet, but the timer itself works.

createlist.description: Lists hold values you can loop over with foreach. Creating a list that already exists does nothing.
createlist.example:
createlist 'ore'
pushlist 'ore' 0x19B9
foreach x in ore
    sysmsg x
endfor

clearlist.summary: Empties a list but keeps it.
clearlist.description: Removes every entry; the list still exists.

removelist.description: Destroys the list entirely. listexists will report false afterwards.

pushlist.summary: Adds a value to a list.
pushlist.description: Appends to the back by default. Add ! to only push when the value is not already in the list.

params.name: 'front' | 'back'
params.desc: Where to insert. Defaults to back.

pushlist.example:
createlist 'ore'
pushlist 'ore' 0x19B9
pushlist! 'ore' 0x19B9   // ! = only if not already present

poplist.summary: Removes a value from a list.
poplist.description: Removes one entry, either by value or from the front or back. Add ! to remove every match instead of one.

createtimer.description: Timers count up in milliseconds. Read them with the timer expression.

settimer.summary: Sets a timer to a value.
settimer.description: Sets the elapsed time in milliseconds, the same as starting it that long ago.

removetimer.description: Destroys the timer. timerexists reports false afterwards.

setvar.summary: Stores a serial in a named variable.
setvar.description: With only a name, the script pauses and asks you to click a target. Pass a serial to set it without prompting. Variables are saved in your profile and survive a restart; add ! to make it script-local instead. 'setvariable' is an alias.

params.name: timeout
params.desc: Milliseconds to wait for your click.

setvar.example:
setvar 'dummy'
cast 'magic arrow'
waitfortarget
target 'dummy'

@setvar! globalTimeout 650   // ! = not persisted, @ = quiet

unsetvar.description: Removes a stored variable. 'unsetvariable' is an alias.

findtypelist.summary: Puts every matching item's serial into a list.
findtypelist.description: Works like findtype, but instead of returning one serial it fills an existing list with all matches. Create the list first.

params.name: source
params.desc: backpack, self, ground, container serial, or true/false.

findtypelist.example:
createlist 'loot'
findtypelist 'loot' 0x0EED ground 0 any 3
foreach item in loot
    dclick item
endfor

script.description: Starts a different script by name. Only one script runs at a time, so this hands over control.

waitforgump.summary: Waits for a gump to open.
waitforgump.description: Blocks until a gump appears. Pass 'any' for the next gump, or an ID to wait for a specific one.

params.name: timeout
params.desc: Milliseconds before giving up. Defaults to 30000.

gumpresponse.description: Answers an open gump. Pass a gump ID to answer a specific gump instead of the last one that opened.

params.name: gumpId
params.desc: Which gump, when several are open.

gumpresponse.example:
waitforgump 'any'
if ingump 'teleport home'
    gumpresponse 4
endif

gumpclose.description: Closes the last gump, or a specific one by ID.

menu.summary: Picks an entry from a context menu.
menu.description: Requests the context menu for an object and selects an entry by index. Pass 0 as the serial to use yourself.

params.name: serial
params.desc: Object whose menu to open. 0 = yourself.

params.name: blockPopup
params.desc: Hide the menu from view. Defaults to true.

menu.example:
# open your own context menu, pick the second entry
menu 0 1

menuresponse.description: Responds to a classic menu (not a context menu).

params.name: hue
params.desc: Hue, when the menu asks for one.

waitformenu.description: Blocks until a classic menu appears.

promptresponse.description: Responds to a server prompt, such as renaming a rune or setting a guild title.

waitforprompt.description: Blocks until the server asks you for text input.

useonce.description: Uses the next item on your UseOnce list. 'add' lets you add an item, 'addcontainer' adds everything in a container.

params.name: 'add' | 'addcontainer'
params.desc: Add items instead of using one.

organizer.description: Runs the numbered organizer agent. 'set' prompts you for its hotbag instead. 'organize' and 'org' are aliases.

params.name: number
params.desc: Agent number, or its alias name.

restock.description: Runs the numbered restock agent. 'set' prompts you for its hotbag instead.

params.name: number
params.desc: Agent number, or its alias name.

scavenger.description: Turns the scavenger on or off, adds items, clears its cache or sets its hotbag. 'scav' is an alias.

params.name: action
params.desc: clear, add, on, off or set.

sell.description: Prompts you to pick the Sell agent's hotbag.

classicuo.description: Sets a ClassicUO profile property at runtime. 'cuo' is an alias.
classicuo.sagasNote: Not supported. The client is compiled ahead-of-time, so it has no reflection with which to reach profile properties. The command still parses and warns instead of breaking your script. We may route it through the assistant interface later.

hp.description: Current hit points. 'hits' is an alias.

maxhp.description: Maximum hit points. 'maxhits' is an alias.
maxhp.example:
if hp != maxhp
    hotkey 'Bandage self'
endif

diffhits.summary: How much health you are missing.
diffhits.description: maxhp minus hp, usually easier to read than comparing both. 'diffhp' is an alias.

maxmana.example:
while mana < maxmana
    skill 'meditation'
    wait 11000
endwhile

poisoned.description: True while your character is poisoned.

paralyzed.description: True while your character cannot move.

hidden.description: True while your character is not visible.

mounted.description: True when something is on your mount layer.

dead.description: Without an argument, true when your character is a ghost. With a serial, true when that mobile is visible as a ghost.

params.name: mobile
params.desc: Serial of the mobile to check. A mobile that is unknown to the client counts as not dead.

dead.example:
if not dead
    # main loop
endif

warmode.description: True when your character is in war mode.

blessed.description: True when your character is blessed / invulnerable. 'invul' and 'invuln' are aliases.

maxweight.description: Maximum weight before you are overloaded.

followers.example:
if followers < maxfollowers
    overhead 'can tame more'
endif

position.summary: True when you stand on these coordinates.
position.description: Compares your position to the given coordinates.

params.name: z
params.desc: World Z. Defaults to your current Z.

position.example:
if position 5923 1145
    overhead 'on the spot'
endif

skill.description: Returns the skill value. Add ! to read the base value instead of the modified one.

findtype.summary: Finds an item or mobile and returns its serial.
findtype.description: Searches for an object by Tiledata name or graphic ID. Returns the serial, or 0 when nothing matches, so it reads as true or false inside an if. Use 'as' to keep the result. Item names support the %s% plural wildcard, e.g. "clean bandage%s%" matches both singular and plural.

params.name: source
params.desc: backpack, self (worn, including container contents), ground, a container serial, or true/false for the CE range check. 'any' skips the slot.

params.name: hue
params.desc: Restrict to one colour. 'any' to ignore.

findtype.example:
if findtype "clean bandage%s%" backpack
    hotkey 'Bandage self'
endif

if findtype 3852 self as PotsHeal
    dclick PotsHeal
endif

find.summary: Checks whether a known serial is present.
find.description: Like findtype, but you already know the serial. Returns the serial when it matches the filters, otherwise 0.

params.name: source
params.desc: backpack, self, ground, or a container serial.

find.example:
if find 0x40001234 backpack
    overhead 'still there'
endif

findlayer.summary: Returns the serial of the item on a layer.
findlayer.description: Looks up what you are wearing on a given layer. Returns 0 when the layer is empty.

params.name: layer
params.desc: Layer name. See the Layers page.

findlayer.example:
if findlayer self righthand as weapon
    getlabel weapon weaponlabel
endif

counttype.description: Adds up the stack sizes of every matching item.

params.name: source
params.desc: backpack, self, ground, or a container serial.

hue.description: Returns the hue of an item or mobile.

noto.description: Returns one of: innocent (blue), friend (green), hostile (grey), criminal (grey), enemy (orange), murderer (red), invulnerable (yellow).

bandaging.summary: Seconds until the current bandage finishes.
bandaging.description: Returns the seconds left on the running bandage; 0 means you are free to apply the next one. Works for healing and veterinary.
bandaging.example:
if bandaging = 0 and hp != maxhp
    hotkey 'Bandage self'
endif
bandaging.sagasNote: Tracked from the bandage messages and estimated at about 8 seconds, because our server sends no bandage timer. Reliable enough to gate a heal loop, but do not treat it as a precise stopwatch.

insysmsg.summary: True when a system message contained this text.
insysmsg.description: Substring search over Razor's recent system messages. Clear the queue first if an old match would confuse you. 'insysmessage' is an alias.
insysmsg.example:
if insysmsg 'You are frozen'
    dclicktype 'pouch' backpack
endif

gumpexists.summary: True when a gump is open.
gumpexists.description: Checks whether a specific gump, or any gump at all, is currently open.

ingump.summary: True when a gump contains this text.
ingump.description: Substring search over the text of an open gump.

params.name: gumpId | 'any'
params.desc: Which gump to search. Defaults to the last one opened.

ingump.example:
waitforgump 'any'
if ingump 'teleport home'
    gumpresponse 4
endif

cooldown.description: Returns the remaining milliseconds, or 0 when the cooldown is finished or unknown, so a bare 'if cooldown' asks whether it is still running.
cooldown.example:
if cooldown 'bandage' > 2000
    overhead 'more than 2s left'
endif

timer.description: Returns how long the timer has been running.

timerexists.description: Checks whether the timer has been created.

list.summary: How many entries a list has.

listexists.description: Checks whether the list has been created.

inlist.summary: True when a list contains a value.

atlist.summary: The entry at a list position.
atlist.description: Returns the value at the given index, counting from 0.
atlist.example:
if atlist 'loot' 0 as first
    dclick first
endif

varexist.description: Checks for a saved variable. Add @ to check script-local variables instead. 'varexists' is an alias.

targetexists.summary: True when a target cursor is up.
targetexists.description: Checks for a target cursor, optionally of a specific kind.

queued.summary: True while Razor still has actions pending.
queued.description: True when the action queue is not empty. Useful to wait for a dress or organizer to finish.
queued.example:
dress 'My Sunday Best'
while queued
    wait 100
endwhile

itemcount.summary: How many items are in your backpack.
itemcount.description: Total item count in your backpack, including containers inside it.
itemcount.example:
if itemcount > 120
    overhead 'pack is full'
endif

count.summary: A counter's value, or how many of an item you carry.
count.description: Reads one of your Display/Counters entries by name. If no counter matches, it counts items of that type instead. 'counter' is an alias.

params.name: 'counter name' | 'name' | graphic
params.desc: Counter name, item name, or graphic ID.

findbuff.summary: True when a buff is active.
findbuff.description: Searches your active buffs by name.
findbuff.example:
if not findbuff 'magic reflection'
    cast 'magic reflection'
endif
findbuff.sagasNote: Always false right now. The buff and debuff packet handler is not wired up yet, so Razor sees no buffs at all. The expression parses and runs, it simply never matches. A fix is planned.

finddebuff.summary: True when a debuff is active.
finddebuff.description: Searches your active debuffs by name.
finddebuff.sagasNote: Always false right now, for the same reason as findbuff: there is no buff or debuff tracking yet.

pvp.summary: True while PvP script restrictions apply.
pvp.description: Reports whether structured-PvP restrictions are limiting what scripts may do.
pvp.sagasNote: Always false. UOSagas has no structured-PvP restriction system, so nothing is ever restricted. The expression stays registered so scripts that use it still parse and run.

rhandempty.summary: True when your right hand is free.
rhandempty.description: True when nothing is equipped on the right hand layer.

lhandempty.summary: True when your left hand is free.
lhandempty.description: True when nothing is equipped on the left hand layer.

diffmana.summary: How much mana you are missing.

diffstam.summary: How much stamina you are missing.

poplist.summary: Removes an entry and returns it.
poplist.description: The expression form of the poplist command: removes the entry and gives you its value.
poplist.example:
while list 'loot' > 0
    if poplist 'loot' 'front' as item
        dclick item
    endif
endwhile

self.description: Resolves to your character's serial. Also valid as a findtype source, where it means everything you are wearing including container contents.

backpack.description: Resolves to your backpack's serial. Also valid as a findtype source.

last.description: Resolves to Razor's Last Target. 'lasttarget' is an alias.

lastobject.description: Resolves to the serial of the last object you double-clicked.

righthand.summary: The item in your right hand.
righthand.description: Resolves to whatever is equipped on the right hand layer, or 0.

lefthand.summary: The item in your left hand.
lefthand.description: Resolves to whatever is equipped on the left hand layer, or 0.

hand.description: Right hand if something is there, otherwise left hand.
